# Shift

> Convert JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF in the browser. Batch, quality, ZIP. No upload.

The public origin is https://shift-local.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

## Tools

* [Convert](https://shift-local.vercel.app) — JPG/PNG/WebP/AVIF in this tab.

## Guides

* [How to convert](https://shift-local.vercel.app/guide) — Steps without an upload API.
* [WebP vs AVIF](https://shift-local.vercel.app/webp-vs-avif) — What each codec actually does here.
* [Compare](https://shift-local.vercel.app/compare) — Side-by-side output.
* [JPG to WebP](https://shift-local.vercel.app/jpg-to-webp) — One job, one codec.
* [AVIF to JPG](https://shift-local.vercel.app/avif-to-jpg) — Decode when the browser can.
* [iPhone](https://shift-local.vercel.app/iphone) — Files vs Photos.
* [WhatsApp](https://shift-local.vercel.app/whatsapp) — Chat recode vs document.
* [Email](https://shift-local.vercel.app/email) — Attachment size.
* [Android](https://shift-local.vercel.app/android) — Gallery recompress.
* [FAQ](https://shift-local.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy and limits.

## Not on this origin

* Bytes stay in the tab. There is no conversion API and no `/blogs/` cluster.
